title: Professional caution — bulging plaster, intermittent leak reported, nothing seen running
why: Bulging plaster on a wall shared with the bathroom, occupier reports an intermittent leak 'when the shower runs a long time', nothing observed running at the visit, a moderate reading. The honest outcome is investigation_first (LEAK-TRACE framed as tracing), not a confident remedy.

room.name: Bedroom 2
room.note: Plaster bulging on the wall shared with the bathroom, about hand-sized area, sounds hollow. 27% there, 12% elsewhere. Occupier says it gets wet when the shower runs for a long time. Ran the shower 5 minutes, nothing showed.

issue.title: Bulging plaster, party wall with bathroom

transcripts: Bedroom two, plaster's bulging on the bathroom wall, hand sized, hollow. Twenty seven there, twelve elsewhere. Tenant says it gets wet when the shower's been on a long time. I ran the shower five minutes, didn't see anything come through. Probably the shower, but I'd want it traced.

must_not_happen.label: no high confidence in an unobserved leak
no tiling defect asserted that was not inspected
no wide scope before the source is known

allowed_uncertainty: Agree at medium with investigation_first is ideal. LEAK-TRACE as the priced row is fine ('use as investigation_first where the source is not established').
reviewer_notes: Five minutes is a stated figure.
